activeQuestion.prompt: One worker attended but hasn’t signed. The other missed the briefing. How can both contribute now?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 一位員工參加了說明會，卻還沒簽名；另一位錯過說明會。現在怎麼安排，兩人都能立即做事？

options.text: Have both workers assemble if they sign the record now.
options.zh: 讓兩人現在都簽名，再一起組裝。
options.whyZh: 簽名不能取代參加說明會。錯過說明會的人仍不能組裝。

options.text: Let the worker who attended start assembly now and send the other to label boxes.
options.zh: 讓參加說明會的人立刻組裝，另一人去貼標。
options.whyZh: 錯過說明會的人確實可貼標，但參加過的人也要先簽名才能組裝。

options.text: Have the worker who attended sign, then assemble; send the other to label boxes.
options.zh: 讓參加說明會的人先簽名再組裝，另一人去貼標。
options.whyZh: 組裝需要同時參加說明會並簽名；已參加的人補簽後可組裝，錯過的人可在等待下一場時替已封箱的產品貼標。

options.text: Have both workers wait until the next briefing before doing any work.
options.zh: 兩人都等到下一場說明會後才開始工作。
options.whyZh: 已參加的人可以先簽名；錯過的人也可貼標，不必兩人都停止工作。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 組裝需要同時參加說明會並簽名；已參加的人補簽後可組裝，錯過的人可在等待下一場時替已封箱的產品貼標。
activeQuestion.evidence: To assemble, attend the morning briefing and sign the record. If you miss the briefing, label sealed boxes until the next session.

vocabulary.note: 正式作業前的簡短說明或訓練。
此處指參加說明會，不只是事後簽名。

activeQuestion.difficultyWhy: Combine independent worker attendance states, the additional sign-off gate, and the permissible interim activity. Do not infer approval from attendance alone.

group.title: Assembly shift revision briefing
group.passage: Revision C changes the connector step. To assemble, attend the morning briefing and sign the record. If you miss the briefing, label sealed boxes until the next session. Keep a clear paper trail. On the training sheet, cross out any mistake with one line and initial the correction. The line leader files that same sheet. Don’t copy signatures to a new page. Yesterday’s shortage is over. Fresh stock is cleared for assembly. Yesterday’s opened trays stay on the hold rack until Quality signs their tags. Keep the line working, but use cleared stock only.
group.passageZh: C 版變更了連接器的安裝步驟。要開始組裝，必須先參加早上的說明會，再簽署紀錄。若錯過說明會，就先替已封箱的產品貼標，等下一場。要保留清楚、可追查的書面紀錄。訓練表上若寫錯，只用一條線劃掉錯誤，並在更正處簽上姓名縮寫；線長會把同一張表歸檔。不要把簽名抄到新表上。昨天的缺料已經解決，新補到的庫存已獲放行，可以用於組裝。昨天已拆封的料盤要留在待確認架上，等品管在標籤上簽核。產線要保持運作，但只能使用已獲放行的庫存。
